{{Top|leg}}
The '''Thrantin blarcluur''' was a type of riding animal. [[Barosa Warren]], the [[Morellian]] founder of the galaxy-renowned [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]], was known to be familiar with Thrantin blarcluurs.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
